{"notes": "Visit 3 (4:00). State of the build: the body line, nose curl and bottom line are all dark (connected to start), and the bottom line now runs out to about x=24.5. The upper tail lobe is built and connected. There is no lower tail lobe, so the fish is still open at the tail end. Nothing pale is stranded. About 6 minutes left.

Maya: Said at 3:30 her lobe was done and connected, and the picture backs that up (the upper tail lobe is connected). She also checked the branch join and asked Tom for status, which is useful coordination. I still didn't see her place dominoes, so I credit the result she reported, not the building. Her first visit (proposing the fish) set direction. Rating leaning solid on execution, good on leadership.

Tom: Now has a delivered result. He said sixteen left at 3:15 and had the bottom line finished at 3:45, and the picture confirms it. That earns back credit for the earlier talk-over-build pattern, though the late start (waiting on Priya) cost time. Good handoff to Leo, and he gave clear status updates. Collaboration is strong.

Priya: Only said she'd check the tail junction, and it looks connected. Her earlier status updates and the finished body line suggest she delivered, but I still haven't seen it directly. Still need to ask about her sketch.

Leo: Biggest concern. Silent this visit, and his lobe, the lower tail, doesn't exist yet. Tom handed it to him at 3:45, so it's only just his turn, but he has been waiting since visit 1 and was told 'queued' at visit 2. Ask him privately what he built and why he didn't start sooner. I can't rate him until I know.

Team: Three people were checking joins while the one remaining piece was unbuilt. Next visit: check the tail lobe is going up and whether anyone helps Leo."}
